description: This Perl module provides a class for caching memoized data in a YAML file, using tied hashes to store and retrieve data, and to persist the cache on destruction.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Memoize::YAML
classes.description: A class implementing tied hash interface to store memoized data in a YAML file.

methods.name: TIEHASH
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the tied hash, loading data from the YAML file if it exists.

methods.name: STORE
methods.description: Stores a value into the tied hash.

methods.name: FETCH
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the tied hash.

methods.name: EXISTS
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the cache.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Dumps the cache data back into the YAML file when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: SCALAR
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the cache.

methods.name: FIRSTKEY
methods.description: Provides a fake hash name when a hash keys is requested.

methods.name: NEXTKEY
methods.description: Returns undef, as no hash iteration is implemented.
